lines.en: label dormwarsfiveio1:
scene iodatewar1
show sunday
$ day = 7
$ totaldays += 1
I didn’t sleep well last night.
lines.zh: 昨晚我没睡好。

lines.en: As it turns out, I’m haunted whether I dream or not. The only difference is the one behind the spectral wheel.
lines.zh: 结果发现，不管我做不做梦，我都被缠着。唯一的区别，只是坐在那张幽灵方向盘后面的人是谁。

lines.en: So I guess I’ll just resign myself to a life where I never feel rested again and let my body get carried off by the wind to whatever dump the universe has in store for me next.
lines.zh: 所以我想，我还是认命吧——认下这辈子再也休息不好的命，让这具身体随风飘到宇宙为我准备的下一个垃圾场去。

lines.en: Something tells me there will be a girl there. That much is all but guaranteed when they’re somehow more accessible to me than air.
lines.zh: 有某种直觉告诉我，那里会有一个女孩。既然她们对我而言不知怎么比空气还容易得到，这几乎是可以打包票的。

lines.en: That isn’t me bragging, I promise. I’m sure you’d be drowning in suitors too if all of the competition suddenly vanished. So maybe you can bank on that.
lines.zh: 我保证这不是在炫耀。我敢说，要是所有的竞争对手突然消失，你也会被追求者淹没。所以这一点你大可放心。

lines.en: Just know that every monkey’s paw is cursed — and being wanted isn’t something I’d suggest you want yourself.
lines.zh: 不过你要知道，每一只猴爪都是被诅咒的——而「被人需要」这件事，我可不建议你去渴求。

lines.en: Of course, there’s always a chance I’m just projecting here. And that you’re off somewhere else, being happier and more loved than I am.
lines.zh: 当然，也有可能我只是在把自己的感受投射出去。而你在别的什么地方，比我更幸福、更被人爱。

lines.en: Actually, come to think of it, that sounds pretty plausible.
lines.zh: 说实话，仔细想想，这听起来还挺有道理的。

lines.en: If that {i}is{/i} the case, though — maybe I can ask you a question this time instead of just providing you with unsolicited advice on how to fuck everything up.
lines.zh: 不过如果情况{i}真是{/i}那样——也许这次我可以问你一个问题，而不是一味地主动奉送该怎么把一切搞砸的建议。

lines.en: Where would I even begin, though?
lines.zh: 可我该从哪儿问起呢？

lines.en: Who are you, maybe?
lines.zh: 你是谁，怎么样？

lines.en: Who have I been talking to this whole time? Who is it that keeps me sane when all else seems to advocate for the opposite?
lines.zh: 这一路上我到底在跟谁说话？在所有其他事物都劝我发疯的时候，是谁让我保持清醒？

lines.en: scene iodatewar2
I don’t even know where to start.
lines.zh: 我甚至不知道该从何说起。

lines.en: We’re so close, yet so far. You know everything about me and I know {i}nothing{/i} about you.
lines.zh: 我们近在咫尺，却又远在天边。你对我的一切了如指掌，而我对你{i}一无所知{/i}。

lines.en: But maybe there’s something that can bring us together.
lines.zh: 不过也许有什么东西能让我们靠近一点。

lines.en: scene iodatewar3
Maybe there’s something that-
lines.zh: 也许有什么东西——

lines.en: scene iodatewar4
scene iodatewar5
: Why do you sleep like that?
lines.zh: : 你怎么睡成那样？

lines.en: : Why are you in my room?
lines.zh: : 你怎么在我房间里？

lines.en: scene iodatewar6
: Why is it already that hard? Are you just like this by default?
lines.zh: : 怎么这么快就难聊了？你天生就是这样吗？

lines.en: : Unfortunately, yes.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，是的。

lines.en: : Gross.
lines.zh: : 恶心。

lines.en: : Thanks, Io. I always love being insulted as soon as I wake up. Now, to get back to my first question-
lines.zh: : 谢了，Io。我一向最爱刚睁眼就被人羞辱。那么，回到我的第一个问题——

lines.en: scene iodatewar7
: Jeez, Sensei. You act like there’s no precedent for this.
lines.zh: : 天哪，Sensei。你这副样子就好像没有前例似的。

lines.en: : Every time you go to sleep, you should be thinking to yourself, “there is a possibility that Io will pick the lock and I will wake up beside her.” Would it kill you to act accordingly?
lines.zh: : 每次你睡觉的时候，都该在心里想一句：「有可能会有人撬锁进来，我一睁眼身边就躺着 Io。」照着这个预期行事，会要了你的命吗？

lines.en: : Kill me, no. But having {i}any{/i} amount of time to myself might be-
lines.zh: : 要命倒不至于。不过能有一{i}丁点{/i}属于自己的时间，也许就——

lines.en: scene iodatewar8
: Actually, nevermind. It’s probably good that you’re here.
lines.zh: : 算了，当我没说。你在这儿也许是件好事。

lines.en: : Right! Plus, this gives us more time for our date! It’s a {i}good{/i} thing my anxiety ate away at me and forced me to sneak into your hotel room again! Praise my broken mind!
lines.zh: : 对啊！而且这样我们的约会时间就更多了！我的焦虑啃噬着我、逼我再一次溜进你的酒店房间，这真是件{i}好{/i}事！赞美我这颗坏掉的脑子！

lines.en: scene iodatewar9
: Maaaaybe put on pants first, though.
lines.zh: : 不——过呢，你还是先把裤子穿上吧。

lines.en: if iosex == True:
: Unless this is the part where you put it inside of me again. Which, as always, ew. But if it earns me any date points and gets you to enjoy my company any more-
lines.zh: : 除非这就是你又要把它放进我里面的环节。那一如既往地，呕。不过要是能给我挣点约会积分、让你更喜欢跟我在一起——

lines.en: : Io, stop that.
lines.zh: : Io，别说了。

lines.en: : I can’t! Conditioning is fun!
lines.zh: : 我做不到！条件反射就是好玩嘛！

lines.en: : Just...go wait outside of the room and I’ll be out in a minute.
lines.zh: : 你……先去房间外面等着，我一会儿就出来。

lines.en: scene iodatewar10
: Fine. But if you escape outside of the window to try and get away from me, just know that it will make me really sad and that I won’t actually do anything about it because I’m weak and I suck.
lines.zh: : 行吧。不过你要是为了躲我从窗户跑出去，我告诉你，我会非常伤心，而且我也不会真的拿你怎么样，因为我软弱又没用。

lines.en: : I will...keep that in mind.
lines.zh: : 我……会记住的。

lines.en: scene black
Io steps out and, hopefully, isn’t accosted by any of her classmates wondering why she’s outside of my room.
lines.zh: Io 走了出去，希望没有哪个同学拦住她、问她为什么在我房门外。

lines.en: I figure it’s either that or {i}all{/i} of them are outside of my room, joined by a camera crew and providing commentary on how they expect this thing to go.
lines.zh: 我想，要么是这样，要么就是她们{i}全{/i}都堵在我房门外，还带着一支摄影组，实时解说她们觉得这事儿会怎么发展。

lines.en: From what I understand, the girls have always really liked this “date war” stuff — even when they’re not the ones who get to take me out.
lines.zh: 据我所知，姑娘们一向很喜欢这种「约会大战」——哪怕轮不到她们带我出去。

lines.en: I think they just like the idea that it {i}could{/i} be them. And that it likely {i}will{/i} be them if we go through enough of these.
lines.zh: 我想她们只是喜欢那种「{i}有可能{/i}是自己」的念头。而且只要我们多来几轮，那个人{i}多半{/i}就会是她们。

lines.en: And I bet all of the ones who are thinking that are jumping for joy right now given that my dates this year are my perpetual best friend and...whatever they see Io as.
lines.zh: 而我敢打赌，此刻这么想的人肯定都乐疯了——毕竟我今年的约会对象，一个是我永远的好朋友，另一个是……随便她们把 Io 看成什么吧。

lines.en: What {i}do{/i} they see Io as?
lines.zh: 她们{i}到底{/i}把 Io 看成什么？

lines.en: I know how Uta does, but...do the rest even see her at all?
lines.zh: 我知道 Uta 怎么看她，可是……其他人真的看得见她吗？

lines.en: Or is going out with her going to be one more situation akin to holding hands with a ghost?
lines.zh: 还是说，跟她约会不过是又一次「牵着一只鬼的手」？

lines.en: scene iodatewar11
Find out now — because we’re already at her favorite place in the world.
lines.zh: 现在就知道了——因为我们已经站在了她在这世上最喜欢的地方。

lines.en: : Green tea...energy drink. Which one is better for spelunking?
lines.zh: : 绿茶……还是能量饮料。哪个更适合探洞？

lines.en: : Which one is better for {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 更适合{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: scene iodatewar12
: Spelunking. It’s when you-
lines.zh: : 探洞啊。就是那个你——

lines.en: : I know what it is, Io.
lines.zh: : 我知道什么是探洞，Io。

lines.en: : Then why did you ask?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么还要问？

lines.en: : Because it’s the first hint of what this “date” has in store and is perhaps the most wildly different scenario I have encountered in all of these so far.
lines.zh: : 因为这是这场「约会」内容的第一个暗示，而且大概是目前为止我遇到的所有场次里最离谱的一个。

lines.en: : Thanks. I take great pride in being an unlikable outcast with fringe interests that may or may not annoy you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。作为一个有冷门爱好、可能讨人厌也可能不讨你厌的边缘人，我感到非常自豪。

lines.en: : You’re a very likable outcast. I’m just not sure if I’m built for cave exploration.
lines.zh: : 你是个非常讨人喜欢的边缘人。我只是不确定我这身子骨适不适合探洞。

lines.en: : Then it sounds to me like you could use a green tea. {i}Or{/i} an energy drink. Which one of those sounds like it would be more useful?
lines.zh: : 那听起来你需要一瓶绿茶。{i}或者{/i}一罐能量饮料。你觉得哪个更有用？

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: scene iodatewar13
: Relax, okay? I’m not throwing you into an actual cave. That’s a third date activity.
lines.zh: : 放松，好吗？我又不会真把你扔进一个真正的洞里。那是第三次约会才做的事。

lines.en: : I’m just taking you back to the secret tunnel that I know you already explored with Uta since {i}I{/i} always wanted to be the one to show you that place.
lines.zh: : 我只是要带你回那条秘密隧道——我知道你已经跟 Uta 探索过了，因为{i}我{/i}一直都想成为带你去那个地方的人。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, why didn’t you then?
lines.zh: : 哦。那当时你为什么没去？

lines.en: : Why do you think?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢？

lines.en: : Because you’re a cowardly loser who gets off on self-inflicted pain?
lines.zh: : 因为你是个胆小的废柴，还喜欢从自找的痛苦里获得快感？

lines.en: scene iodatewar14
: I mean, that’s not really how {i}I{/i} would word it. But yeah, that’s more or less the answer I was looking for. The only problem is I still don’t know what to buy you.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，{i}我{/i}大概不会这么说。不过对，那差不多就是我想听到的答案。唯一的问题是，我还是不知道该给你买什么。

lines.en: : Wait, it’s for me?
lines.zh: : 等等，是买给我的？

lines.en: : Yeah. Am I not supposed to buy you things? We’re on a date.
lines.zh: : 对啊。我不该给你买东西吗？我们可是在约会。

lines.en: : Isn’t that usually-
lines.zh: : 通常不是——

lines.en: : If you’re about to perpetuate gender norms at me, let it be known that I am far more traditionally masculine than you are.
lines.zh: : 你要是打算拿性别刻板印象来对付我，那我先声明，我可比你阳刚多了。

lines.en: : I hate that you’re right.
lines.zh: : 我讨厌你居然是对的。

lines.en: scene iodatewar15
: Don’t! Because that stuff doesn’t matter!
lines.zh: : 别！因为那种东西根本不重要！

lines.en: : It clearly matters {i}a little{/i} if you’ve aimed all of your hate specifically at girls and not-
lines.zh: : 要是你把全部的恨都专门对准了女生而不是——那它{i}多少{/i}还是有点重要的。

lines.en: : Okaaaay, so it matters in some specific circumstances! But again, I am a hypocrite! And I think the important thing right now is taking into account that I am bringing {i}you{/i} on a date!
lines.zh: : 好——吧，那它在某些特定情况下确实重要！不过再说一次，我就是个双标！而且我觉得现在重要的是，我是在带{i}你{/i}约会！

lines.en: : Doesn’t it make the most sense for the date aggressor to be the one who has to provide material goods for the date prey?
lines.zh: : 让约会的主动方负责给约会的猎物提供物质享受，不是最合情合理吗？

lines.en: : Sorry, are you calling me your {i}prey{/i} right now?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你这是在叫我{i}猎物{/i}？

lines.en: : Just because I’m nervous and couldn’t think of a better word! Beverage?
lines.zh: : 只是因为我太紧张、想不出更好的词！饮料呢？

lines.en: : Give me the tea.
lines.zh: : 给我茶。

lines.en: scene iodatewar16
: As expected of the prey.
lines.zh: : 不愧是猎物。

lines.en: : Fine. Give me the energy drink, then.
lines.zh: : 行。那给我能量饮料。

lines.en: scene black
: Nope! You’ve already made up your mind!
lines.zh: : 不行！你已经做出决定了！

lines.en: : Come, Sensei! Or shall I say — {i}darling,{/i} ala romantic stereotypes that mean nothing to me but make me feel weirdly warm inside now that I say them out loud.
lines.zh: : 来吧，Sensei！或者我该叫你——{i}亲爱的，{/i}照着那些对我毫无意义的浪漫套路来，可真说出来的时候，心里居然莫名地发暖。

lines.en: scene sky
Hanging out with Io on a date is kind of like...well, the way it always is when I hang out with Io. Just slightly more...cute, I guess?
lines.zh: 跟 Io 约会的感觉有点像……嗯，就像平时跟她混在一起那样。只是稍微……更可爱一点，我想？

lines.en: Which isn’t to say she isn’t normally cute. She’s adorable when she’s not insulting everyone she knows (including herself).
lines.zh: 倒不是说她平时不可爱。只要她不在骂她认识的每一个人（包括她自己），她还是很招人喜欢的。

lines.en: But she’s extra attentive today. And keeps offering me snacks out of a large plastic bag she’s been clutching ever since we left the convenience store.
lines.zh: 不过她今天格外体贴。还不停地从一个大塑料袋里掏零食给我——从我们离开便利店起，那个袋子就被她攥在手里。

lines.en: Which — and hear me out here because this is going to sound weird due to the fact that I am attracted to her — makes her feel almost...grandmotherly?
lines.zh: 这一点——你先听我说完，因为我知道我本来就对她有感觉，所以听起来会很怪——让她几乎有种……老奶奶的感觉？

lines.en: Like, Touka never offers me snacks. Or spends ten minutes on a walk to a secret tunnel talking about the effects of various sleeping pills.
lines.zh: 比如，Touka 从来不会给我零食。也不会在走向秘密隧道的十分钟路上，跟我讲各种安眠药的效果。

lines.en: I swear, it’s like Io is one or two steps away from calling me “Sonny Boy” and selling me a membership badge so I can use the community pool.
lines.zh: 我发誓，Io 简直就差叫我一声「小伙子」，再卖给我一枚会员徽章，好让我去用小区的泳池。

lines.en: Wait, what?
lines.zh: 等等，什么？

lines.en: Why did I-
lines.zh: 我为什么会——

lines.en: scene iodatewar17
: Sensei — you’ve been counting our steps, right?
lines.zh: : Sensei——你一直在数我们走过的步数，对吧？

lines.en: : Our steps? I thought all I had to do was count the amount of turns we made and stuff.
lines.zh: : 步数？我以为我只要数我们拐了几个弯之类的就行。

lines.en: : Yeah, that. Status report, navigator. Your captain has issued a command.
lines.zh: : 对，就是那个。报告状态，领航员。你的船长下命令了。

lines.en: : Thirteen lefts and nine rights. Obviously not in that order.
lines.zh: : 十三次左转，九次右转。当然不是按这个顺序。

lines.en: : I’ve also been keeping track of that part. But how many-
lines.zh: : 那部分我也在记。不过有多少——

lines.en: : Fifteen grates or vents or...whatever it is you want to call them. With the most recent being literally right behind us.
lines.zh: : 十五个格栅，或者通风口，或者……随便你想叫什么。最近的一个就在我们正后方。

lines.en: scene iodatewar18
: Roger! We’re probably getting close then.
lines.zh: : 收到！那我们大概快到了。

lines.en: : To {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 快到{i}哪儿{/i}？

lines.en: : The end of the line! Where the new half of town meets the old half and causes a rift in the time and space continuum we can throw ourselves into to become finally happy!
lines.zh: : 终点站！新城区的那一半和旧城区的那一半相接的地方，那里的时空连续体裂开了一道缝，我们可以纵身跳进去，从此终于幸福！

lines.en: scene iodatewar19
: Oh. Well, why didn’t you just say so? A time rift is way better than how dates normally end. And significantly more your speed.
lines.zh: : 哦。那你干嘛不早说？时空裂缝可比约会的常规收尾好多了。而且明显更合你的路子。

lines.en: : That’d be cool, wouldn’t it? Unfortunately, I am a liar. And I am leading you to a secret location where I can murder you and conveniently dispose of the body.
lines.zh: : 那会很酷，对吧？可惜我是个骗子。我正在把你带往一个秘密地点，好在那儿杀了你，再顺手处理掉尸体。

lines.en: : This day just keeps getting better.
lines.zh: : 这一天真是越来越精彩了。

lines.en: : Okay, no more lies this time. There’s a secret room built into the wall with a high-tech keypad that we’re going to crack the code for together.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这次不说谎了。墙上嵌着一间密室，配了个高科技键盘，我们要一起破解密码。

lines.en: : I thought you said no more lies?
lines.zh: : 你不是说不再说谎了吗？

lines.en: : I did. I’m serious this time.
lines.zh: : 我是说了。这次我是认真的。

lines.en: scene iodatewar20
: I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，什么？

lines.en: : Did Uta not tell you about it? I know we promised to keep it a secret, but I figured she would have blabbed to {i}you{/i} since you guys are like, a {i}thing{/i} now and stuff.
lines.zh: : Uta 没跟你说过吗？我知道我们约好要保密，不过我猜她八成会跟你漏了口风，毕竟你们现在也算是一{i}对{/i}了什么的。

lines.en: : We’re not {i}a thing,{/i} Io.
lines.zh: : 我们不是{i}一对{/i}，Io。

lines.en: : You {i}better{/i} be a thing, Sensei. Because if I find out you’re using my best friend, I will once again be very sad but ultimately not do anything about it.
lines.zh: : 你们{i}最好{/i}是一对，Sensei。因为要是让我发现你在玩弄我最好的朋友，我又会非常伤心，但最终还是什么都做不了。

lines.en: : Like {i}really{/i} sad this time, though. And I’ll probably hate you for a few minutes before caving and convincing myself I don’t.
lines.zh: : 不过这次会是{i}真的{/i}很伤心。而且我大概会恨你几分钟，然后就投降，说服自己并不恨你。

lines.en: scene iodatewar21
: If you’re worried about me using her or something, I can promise that’s not what’s happening.
lines.zh: : 如果你担心我是在玩弄她什么的，我可以保证不是那样。

lines.en: : Uta’s...important, obviously. But I think that she understands just as well as me that I am being pulled in a million different directions and...one of those just happens to be her.
lines.zh: : Uta 显然……很重要。但我想她和我一样清楚，我正被一百万个方向拉扯，而……其中一个恰好是她。

lines.en: scene iodatewar22
: If that upsets you, I get it. But it’s not like-
lines.zh: : 如果这让你不高兴，我理解。不过又不是——

lines.en: : Something’s different.
lines.zh: : 有什么不对劲。

lines.en: scene iodatewar23
: I know. That’s what I’m trying to-
lines.zh: : 我知道。我正想说——

lines.en: : Not with you and Uta. With the tunnel. Be quiet.
lines.zh: : 不是说你和 Uta。是隧道。闭嘴。

lines.en: scene iodatewar24
: Can you hear that?
lines.zh: : 你听到了吗？

lines.en: : I can’t really hear anything. But you know this place better than me, so-
lines.zh: : 我什么都听不见。不过你比我熟这儿，所以——

lines.en: : You’re sure we’ve passed fifteen sewer grates, right?
lines.zh: : 你确定我们已经走过十五个下水道格栅了，对吧？

lines.en: : I...think so? But keep in mind that I never claimed to be an effective navigator. So if we’ve gotten lost, I think you should take some of the blame for bringing me here.
lines.zh: : 我……应该吧？不过别忘了，我可从没说过自己是个靠谱的领航员。所以要是迷路了，我觉得你把我带到这儿来，也得担点责任。

lines.en: : No, I don’t think we’re lost. I kept the instructions on my phone. There’s just...something different. And I’m not sure what-
lines.zh: : 不，我觉得我们没迷路。路线说明我存在手机里了。只是……有什么不一样了。我不确定是——

lines.en: scene iodatewar25
: Is that...light? Do you see that?
lines.zh: : 那是……光吗？你看到了吗？

lines.en: : A light at the end of a tunnel? Did it cave in on us while we were bickering or something? Are we dead now?
lines.zh: : 隧道尽头的光？该不会是我们拌嘴的时候塌了吧？我们现在是死了吗？

lines.en: : It’s not just one. It’s...
lines.zh: : 不只是一道光。是……

lines.en: scene black
: Come on! Let’s check it out!
lines.zh: : 快来！我们去看看！

lines.en: : Io, don’t run. It’s dark in here and I don’t want to have to carry you out if-
lines.zh: : Io，别跑。这儿很黑，我可不想还得把你背出去，万一——

lines.en: scene iodatewar26

lines.zh: : 万一……

lines.en: : Holy shit...
lines.zh: : 我的天哪……

lines.en: Right there in the middle of the tunnel is a ledge, haphazardly marked with several small street barriers as if it {i}doesn’t{/i} just suddenly descend into nothing but a sea of black.
lines.zh: 隧道正中有一道岩台，周围随意摆着几个小小的路障，仿佛它{i}并不是{/i}突然就直落进一片漆黑的海洋。

lines.en: From out its depths crawl thousands of dust particles, illuminated and brought to life by the light of the sun, falling endlessly from a separate abyss extending above.
lines.zh: 从那深处爬出成千上万的尘埃微粒，被阳光照亮、激活，从上方另一处深渊里无止境地飘落。

lines.en: I can hear water. I can hear air. I can hear everything. But at the same time, there’s an inescapable, terrifying silence that finds its way between Io and me.
lines.zh: 我能听见水声。能听见风声。能听见一切。可与此同时，有一种无法逃避、令人恐惧的寂静，钻进了我和 Io 之间。

lines.en: The two of us feed that silence in our confusion, left to do nothing but stand there and gawk at one more inexplicable feat of this even more inexplicable city.
lines.zh: 我们俩在困惑中喂养着这份寂静，只能站在那儿，呆望着这座本就不可思议的城市又一次不可思议的造物。

lines.en: Just {i}I{/i} am used to this. And {i}she{/i} is-
lines.zh: 只是{i}我{/i}已经习惯了。而{i}她{/i}——

lines.en: : This...
: Is so...
lines.zh: : 真是……

lines.en: scene iodatewar27
: Fucking cool!
lines.zh: : 他妈的太酷了！

lines.en: : We encounter an endless pit of darkness in the middle of a tunnel, coming one or two steps from falling into it, and your response is to call it {i}cool?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们在隧道正中间撞见一个深不见底的黑洞，离掉进去只差一两步，而你的反应是夸它{i}酷{/i}？

lines.en: scene iodatewar28
: Fuck yeah it is! Who gives a shit about a secret door with a dumb keypad when we’ve found the edge of the friggin’ world?!
lines.zh: : 当然他妈的酷啊！我们都找到了这该死的世界的边缘，谁还在乎一扇配着破键盘的密门啊？！

lines.en: scene iodatewar29
: Don’t jump in, though. And don’t push me either. I was only joking when I talked about hiding your body. I swear I didn’t know this was here.
lines.zh: : 不过别跳进去。也别推我。我说要藏你尸体的时候只是在开玩笑。我发誓我不知道这儿有这个。

lines.en: scene iodatewar30
: This is so weird, though. I’ve been down here with Uta tons of times and we’ve never seen anything like this. It’s almost like the tunnel is-
lines.zh: : 不过这也太奇怪了。我跟 Uta 来过这儿好多次，从来没见过这种东西。就好像这条隧道在——

lines.en: : Changing?
lines.zh: : 变化？

lines.en: : Yeah...
scene iodatewar31
: But if that’s the case, what are these barrier things doing here? Don’t they indicate that someone knows about this?
lines.zh: : 可如果是这样，那些路障是干嘛的？难道不是说明有人知道这儿的情况吗？

lines.en: : Construction maybe?
lines.zh: : 也许是施工？

lines.en: : New businesses are popping up all over the place. Maybe one of them was connected to the tunnels and-
lines.zh: : 新店铺到处都在冒出来。也许其中哪家跟隧道连通了，然后——

lines.en: : No, that wouldn’t explain how deep it is. The only thing that would-
lines.zh: : 不，那解释不了它有多深。唯一能解释的是——

lines.en: scene iodatewar32
: Ah! Sensei! Do you know what I think this is?!
lines.zh: : 啊！Sensei！你知道我觉得这是什么吗？！

lines.en: : A rift in the time and space continuum that we can throw ourselves into to become happy?
lines.zh: : 一道时空连续体的裂缝，我们可以跳进去从此幸福？

lines.en: : No! But you’re close!
lines.zh: : 不是！不过很接近了！

lines.en: scene iodatewar33
: I think this might be the sinkhole that swallowed the school Uta and I transferred in from.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这可能是那个天坑——就是吞掉我和 Uta 转学过来的那所学校的那个。

lines.en: : I don’t really see how that’s close, but okay.
lines.zh: : 我没看出来这哪里接近了，不过行吧。

lines.en: : It’s close because it’s a crack in reality! Something that {i}shouldn’t{/i} happen, but did.
lines.zh: : 接近是因为它是一道现实的裂缝！一件{i}本不该{/i}发生、却发生了的事。

lines.en: : No one expects an entire school to just disappear, just like no one expects a rift that grants happiness to open up somewhere in the sky or wherever it is rifts form.
lines.zh: : 没人料到一整所学校会凭空消失，就像没人料到天上——或者随便裂缝是在哪儿形成的——会裂开一道赐予幸福的缝。

lines.en: : Well...if it is, what does that mean?
lines.zh: : 嗯……如果真是，那意味着什么？

lines.en: scene iodatewar34
: That I can finally get my old pencil case back!
lines.zh: : 意味着我终于能把我的旧笔袋拿回来了！

lines.en: : Io, please don’t tell me you’re actually planning on jumping into a giant hole that disappears into nothingness.
lines.zh: : Io，别告诉我你真打算跳进一个通向虚无的大洞里。

lines.en: : Jumping? No. We just need a lot of rope.
lines.zh: : 跳？不。我们只需要很多绳子。

lines.en: : Please don’t venture into the sinkhole. This is a formal request from your former teacher.
lines.zh: : 请别冒险下天坑。这是你前任老师的正式请求。

lines.en: scene iodatewar35
: Aww, Sensei. I’ve always wanted someone to be worried enough about me to ask me not to jump into a bottomless pit.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，Sensei。我一直都希望有谁能担心我到求我别往无底坑里跳。

lines.en: : Well, if it’s actually the sinkhole that claimed your school, it {i}would{/i} have a bottom. Right?
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果它真是吞掉你们学校的那天坑，那它{i}应该{/i}是有底的。对吧？

lines.en: : Oh, you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道我什么意思。

lines.en: scene iodatewar36
: What do we do now, though? Like, we’re obviously not the first ones to find it based on the barriers. But I can’t just {i}ignore{/i} something as cool as this.
lines.zh: : 那我们现在怎么办？你看，有那些路障在，我们显然不是第一批发现的。可我没法就这么{i}无视{/i}这么酷的东西。

lines.en: : So...what? You want to keep investigating?
lines.zh: : 所以……怎样？你想继续调查？

lines.en: : I say we regroup. We’ll return to the surface and enlist the help of Uta to go scream into the sinkhole from the top and see if we can hear her from down here.
lines.zh: : 我建议我们重整旗鼓。先回到地面，拉上 Uta，让她从上面朝天坑里喊，看看我们在下面能不能听见她。

lines.en: : Do they not have the hole blocked off up there?
lines.zh: : 上面不是把那个洞封起来了吗？

lines.en: : They do. But we’ve snuck into plenty of stuff we’re not allowed into. It’s one of the ways we bond.
lines.zh: : 是封了。不过我们溜进去过好多不让进的地方。这是我们增进感情的方式之一。

lines.en: : You do realize I still have another date after this, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我之后还有一场约会的，对吧？

lines.en: : You do realize that no date you could ever go on after this one will possibly live up to the wonder of a giant hole, right?
lines.zh: : 你也该知道，这场之后你再怎么约会，都不可能比得上一个大洞带来的震撼吧？

lines.en: : The giant hole is only a wonder at all because I got to see it with you.
lines.zh: : 那个大洞之所以震撼，只是因为我是跟你一起看的。

lines.en: : I still think it’d be pretty cool even if I were by myself right now.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得，就算现在只有我一个人，它也挺酷的。

lines.en: : Then I guess that just means I like you more.
lines.zh: : 那看来只是意味着我更喜欢你。

lines.en: : I respectfully disagree.
lines.zh: : 我恭敬地表示不同意。

lines.en: : Actually, no. I disrespectfully disagree. I think you are wrong and dumb and that I like you more. And I will not apologize for this assessment of our relationship.
lines.zh: : 不，重新来。我不恭敬地表示不同意。我觉得你又错又蠢，而且我更喜欢你。对于我对我们关系的这番评价，我不会道歉。

lines.en: : Oh. Okay.
lines.zh: : 哦。好吧。

lines.en: : Also, you should kiss me.
lines.zh: : 另外，你该吻我。

lines.en: scene iodatewar37
: Like...now?
lines.zh: : 就……现在？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m jealous that Uta gets to and I don’t.
lines.zh: : 对。我嫉妒 Uta 能亲而你没亲过我。

lines.en: : But I also understand if you’re disgusted by the idea of doing something like that with me since you won’t be my first.
lines.zh: : 不过我也理解，要是你一想到跟我做这种事就觉得恶心——毕竟你不会是我的第一个。

lines.en: scene iodatewar38
: That doesn’t disgust me, Io.
lines.zh: : 那不让我恶心，Io。

lines.en: : It should.
lines.zh: : 应该的。

lines.en: : But you can take solace in the fact that this will be my first {i}consensual{/i} kiss if that helps wash away any of the grossness.
lines.zh: : 不过你可以这样安慰自己：这会是我第一次{i}出于自愿{/i}的吻——如果这能冲淡一点恶心感的话。

lines.en: : There’s nothing gross about you.
lines.zh: : 你身上没有任何恶心的东西。

lines.en: : Yes there is.
lines.zh: : 有的。

lines.en: : No...there’s not.
lines.zh: : 不……没有。

lines.en: : I respectfully disagree.
lines.zh: : 我恭敬地表示不同意。

lines.en: : Actually, no. I disrespectfully disagree. I think you are wrong and dumb and that I am damaged beyond repair.
lines.zh: : 不，重新来。我不恭敬地表示不同意。我觉得你又错又蠢，而且我已经坏到修不好了。

lines.en: : That statement implies I want to fix you.
lines.zh: : 这话暗示着我想修好你。

lines.en: : Do you not?
lines.zh: : 你不想吗？

lines.en: : No. I fear that “fixed” Io would be unrecognizable, so I’m willing to accept whatever spare pieces and parts this one has left to offer.
lines.zh: : 不想。我怕「修好的」Io 会变得让人认不出来，所以我愿意接受眼前这个 Io 还能拿出来的任何零碎部件。

lines.en: : They are yours if you will have them. But I would like to ask for something of yours in return, if that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 只要你肯要，它们就都是你的。不过我也想问你要一样东西作为交换，可以吗？

lines.en: : And what is it you would like?
lines.zh: : 那你想要什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know yet.
lines.zh: : 我还不知道。

lines.en: : And to be honest, I’m not sure I ever will. So don’t be surprised if I continue to ask for something new every day for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我不确定自己会不会有知道的那天。所以如果我在往后的永恒里每天都问你要点新东西，你可别惊讶。

lines.en: : Or at least until one of us falls into the sinkhole.
lines.zh: : 或者至少，直到我们中的某一个掉进天坑里为止。

lines.en: scene iodatewar39
: Are you really sure you want to do this?
lines.zh: : 你真的确定想这么做吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不确定。

lines.en: : Should I...stop then?
lines.zh: : 那我……停下来？

lines.en: : No.
: I am receiving mixed signals here that I feel like I shouldn’t ignore based on your history.
lines.zh: : 我收到的信号很矛盾，而看你的过去，我觉得我不该无视它。

lines.en: : Frankly speaking, Sensei, I’d like to forget basically all of my history that doesn’t involve you or Uta.
lines.zh: : 老实说，Sensei，我过去的一切里，凡是不涉及你或 Uta 的，我基本上都想忘掉。

lines.en: : And, assuming that’s possible, I think having my “first” kiss in front of a bottomless pit sounds like a pretty great memory and the perfect end to an {i}actual{/i} first date.
lines.zh: : 而假设那可行的话，我觉得在无底坑前献出我的「初」吻，听起来会是很棒的回忆，也是一场{i}真正{/i}初次约会的完美收尾。

lines.en: : I still feel like this is wrong and that I should give you more time.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得这样不对，觉得我该给你更多时间。

lines.en: : Okay. I’ll just do it myself then.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我自己来好了。

lines.en: : You’ll-
lines.zh: : 你会——

lines.en: scene iodatewar40
: Mmf?
: Chu...chu...chu...
scene iodatewar41
I melt into her.
lines.zh: 我在她怀里融化了。

lines.en: : Heheh...chu...heh...
But she starts...laughing?
lines.zh: 可她开始……笑？

lines.en: scene iodatewar42
: Hm? Why’d you stop?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你怎么停了？

lines.en: : People don’t normally laugh.
lines.zh: : 一般人接吻的时候不会笑。

lines.en: : Really? It kind of tickles. Kissing like this.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？这样亲有点痒。亲吻这种事。

lines.en: : Plus, you look dumb when you have to crouch down like that. It’s cute.
lines.zh: : 再说了，你得弯下腰来亲我的样子看起来傻乎乎的。挺可爱。

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: : Keep going. I want more.
lines.zh: : 继续。我还想要。

lines.en: scene iodatewar41
I melt again.
lines.zh: 我又融化了。

lines.en: scene black
And all I am drips slowly from the ledge that leads into a sea of nothing.
lines.zh: 而我的全部，从那道通向虚无之海的岩台上慢慢滴落。

$ dormwarsfiveio1 = True
{i}Io’s affection has increased to [io_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Io 的好感度提升到了 [io_love]!{/i}
